messages:
reena: Heads-up: new user followed the quickstart and said the web console showed \"Billing accepted\" but the sample app printed \"Done\" with no generated text. They pasted logs and a curl.

omar: can you paste the curl + raw response? which sdk/sample?

reena: curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-zzzz\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"open-7b","input":"hi"}'
```
response headers: content-type: application/json, x-org-state: billing:accepted,pending-verify
body:
{"id":"r_999","status":"preview","detail":"billing_verification_pending","message":"Billing accepted; verification in progress. Generation temporarily limited to preview","streaming":false}
connection closed. SDK: js-sdk 1.4.2, sample: quickstart web demo (prints \"Done\").

support: user is scared because dashboard shows token usage for the attempt. billing-bot?

billing-bot: Clarify: when billing is accepted but verification (AVS/payment verification) is pending we allow a limited preview mode for stability checks. We log a preview footprint but do not invoice until verification completes. Some UI surfaces show the attempt and it looks like usage; we'll add a qualifier.

omar: JS 1.4.2 streaming parser expects ndjson chunks and treats a single JSON+close as an empty event stream. It then prints \"Done\" in the sample. This is a parity bug — other SDKs (python) inspect body and raise a BillingVerificationPending error.

reena: user accepted billing in UI earlier; why are we in verification pending state?

billing-bot: In this case the card was added but payment verification is still pending (AVS delay). We mark org state billing:accepted,pending-verify and gate generation to preview until verification completes.

omar: short term: support message to user: verification usually completes within 1-2 hours; retry after verification or create a billing-enabled dev workspace. Long term: infra should not return 200+preview for gating; use 402/403 or set X-Redwood-Gating header for clients to detect.

reena: action items: 1) JS SDK patch to detect body.detail=="billing_verification_pending" or status=="preview" with streaming==false and throw BillingVerificationPendingError instead of returning an empty stream. 2) Infra ticket to standardize gating codes/headers. 3) Docs/CS blurb explaining verification vs accepted vs preview footprint. 4) Quickstart: change \"Done\" to more explicit final message and surface error details when present.

omar: I'll open a small patch for js-sdk@1.4.5 to handle these sentinels and avoid retrying on 4xx or preview bodies. I'll include a unit test that simulates x-org-state header and a 200-with-preview-body. Ticket DX-9900.

billing-bot: Dashboard team filed FIN-2911 to show \"preview attempts not invoiced\" tooltip and filter by attempt type.

support: sent user guidance and they waited ~90 minutes; after verification the same quickstart returned streaming text. user confirmed and is unblocked.

devex-bot: js-sdk@1.4.5 published (patch) - raises BillingVerificationPendingError for preview bodies; updated quickstart sample to print helpful guidance.

reena: thanks team. let's also add a short note in the onboarding checklist so CS knows to look for verification step in addition to billing acceptance. closing after FIN-2911 and DX-9900 land. :white_check_mark:
